title: Cambridge IELTS 14 Test 3 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The diagram below shows how electricity is generated in a hydroelectric power station.
scenario: The diagram shows a hydroelectric power station operating through a day-and-night cycle between a high-level reservoir and a low-level reservoir.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Hydroelectric power station
labels: Flow of water to generate electricity (day)
Night: pump water into high-level reservoir
notes: During the day, the intake is open and water flows from the high-level reservoir through the reversible turbines to the low-level reservoir. The turbines operate the generator, and electricity is transmitted by power lines to the national grid.
At night, the intake is closed and the reversible turbines pump water from the low-level reservoir back into the high-level reservoir.
